description: GB passenger trains running late right now, and trains booked to be running now that are cancelled (wholly or part of the way). Each train has its route, how late it is, where it last reported, where it calls next, the reason Darwin gives, and a Delay Repay link once a claim is worth making. Optionally filter by operator (name or two-letter code) or set the lateness threshold.

limit.description: Maximum trains to return, 1-50, cancellations first, then the latest.

minLate.description: Minutes late to count as late, 1-120. Default 5.

operatorName.description: Operator name or code, e.g. 'Northern' or 'NT'.

name: late_trains
title: Trains late or cancelled now
